albums.title: The Grateful Dead
albums.cardBlurb: The four-day debut — two originals and seven electrified folk/blues covers, from Golden Road to Viola Lee Blues.

albums.title: Anthem of the Sun
albums.cardBlurb: The studio/live collage — That's It for the Other One suite, Alligator, and Caution, chords verified where charts exist.

albums.title: Aoxomoxoa
albums.cardBlurb: St. Stephen, China Cat Sunflower, Cosmic Charlie — the 16-track experiment, chords verified.

albums.title: Workingman's Dead
albums.cardBlurb: The acoustic pivot — Uncle John's Band, Casey Jones, Dire Wolf, and the rest, verified chords and numbers.

albums.title: American Beauty
albums.cardBlurb: Box of Rain through Truckin' — all ten tracks with verified chords, numbers, and links.

albums.title: Wake of the Flood
albums.cardBlurb: Eyes of the World, Stella Blue, Row Jimmy and the Weather Report Suite — the first album on their own label.

albums.title: From the Mars Hotel
albums.cardBlurb: Scarlet Begonias, U.S. Blues, Ship of Fools — plus Unbroken Chain, the Phil Lesh bass showcase.

albums.title: Blues for Allah
albums.cardBlurb: Help on the Way → Slipknot! → Franklin's Tower, Crazy Fingers, and the instrumental suites.

albums.title: Terrapin Station
albums.cardBlurb: Estimated Prophet in 7/4, Samson and Delilah, and the full Terrapin suite charted section by section.

albums.title: Shakedown Street
albums.cardBlurb: The disco-inflected one — Shakedown Street, I Need a Miracle, Stagger Lee, Fire on the Mountain.

albums.title: Reckoning
albums.cardBlurb: 16 tracks, verified chords, Nashville numbers, and lyric links for the Dead's acoustic live double album.

albums.title: Dead Set
albums.cardBlurb: Reckoning's electric twin — 13 songs plus Drums/Space, with verified chords, numbers, and links.
